description: PostgreSQL counterparts of the VERUS_SQL T2 scalar meaning pins (verus/pins/scalar.rs): numeric result scales, int4 overflow and int4/int8 promotion, cross-type numeric comparison, date + interval with month-end clamping, date vs timestamp comparison and timestamp range overflow. One-row table `one` so every expression has a FROM; `d` holds month-end dates, `far` a date one month before the end of the timestamp range.

cases.name: numeric_scales
cases.sql: SELECT 0.06 - 0.01 AS a, 1.50 * 0.25 AS b, 1 - 0.05 AS c, 0.1 - 0.012 AS d FROM one
cases.note: pin_numeric_arithmetic: add/sub keep max scale, mul adds scales (0.05, 0.3750, 0.95, 0.088).

cases.name: int4_overflow
cases.sql: SELECT k + 2147483647 AS x FROM one

cases.name: int4_int8_promotion
cases.sql: SELECT k + 2147483648 AS x, k * 3 AS y FROM one
cases.note: 2147483648 is an int8 literal: the int4 side is promoted, no overflow (2147483649); int4*int4 stays int4.

cases.name: numeric_comparisons
cases.sql: SELECT k FROM one WHERE 24 > 23.99 AND 1.0 = 1.00 AND -0.5 < -0.49
cases.note: pin_comparisons_and_3vl: exact cross-type/cross-scale numeric comparison; the row stays.

cases.name: month_end_clamp_literals
cases.sql: SELECT DATE '2024-01-31' + INTERVAL '1' MONTH AS a, DATE '2023-01-31' + INTERVAL '1' MONTH AS b, DATE '2000-02-29' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR AS c, DATE '1998-12-01' - INTERVAL '90' DAY AS d, DATE '2024-03-31' - INTERVAL '1' MONTH AS e FROM one
cases.note: pin_dates_and_intervals: date + interval is a timestamp; month arithmetic clamps to the month end.

cases.name: month_end_clamp_column
cases.sql: SELECT n, dt + INTERVAL '1' MONTH AS plus_month, dt - INTERVAL '1' MONTH AS minus_month, dt + INTERVAL '1' YEAR AS plus_year FROM d
cases.note: The same clamping on a date column (bag).

cases.name: date_vs_timestamp
cases.sql: SELECT k FROM one WHERE DATE '1994-12-31' < DATE '1994-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR AND NOT (DATE '1995-01-01' < DATE '1994-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR)
cases.note: Q6's upper bound: date vs timestamp comparison is exact (1994-12-31 inside, 1995-01-01 outside).

cases.name: timestamp_overflow_literal
cases.sql: SELECT DATE '294276-12-01' + INTERVAL '1' MONTH AS t FROM one
cases.note: pin_datetime_errors: the timestamp leaves PostgreSQL's range (22008). The frontend refuses the six-digit year literal (recorded refusal).

cases.name: timestamp_overflow_column
cases.sql: SELECT dt + INTERVAL '1' MONTH AS t FROM far
cases.note: pin_datetime_errors on a stored date: 294276-12-01 + 1 month leaves the timestamp range (22008).
